neighbours.label: the preposition ' of' linking a head noun or adjective to its complement (results of, proceedings of, convinced of)
fire: The committee published the full results of the survey last week.
She spent the remainder of her career teaching in a small village school.
By then the engineer had become convinced of the need for a new bridge.
The minutes of the meeting were mailed to every member on Friday.
We studied the history of the railway for most of the term.
Visitors admired the beauty of the old cathedral at sunset.
The report describes the causes of the flood in great detail.
He was proud of the garden he had planted with his father.
